jsonld.name: 4K’s BBQ and Catering
jsonld.description: Barbecue restaurant and catering company in Clearwater, FL, smoking pork ribs, beef ribs, brisket and pulled pork daily and serving private events.

script.en: Low and slow, served with pride.

parrafo.es: 4K's BBQ and Catering es un local de barbacoa y catering en Clearwater, FL. Ahuman carnes todos los días (costillas de cerdo, costillas de res, pulled pork y brisket) y arman el catering completo para cumpleaños, bodas y eventos de empresa, con guarniciones caseras como mac and cheese, frijoles y collard greens.
parrafo.en: 4K's BBQ and Catering is a barbecue joint and catering company in Clearwater, FL. They smoke meat fresh every day, including pork ribs, beef ribs, pulled pork and brisket, and handle full catering for birthdays, weddings and company events, with homemade sides like mac and cheese, baked beans and collard greens.

parrafo_1.es: 4K's BBQ and Catering ahúma sus carnes a diario en Clearwater: costillas de cerdo, costillas de res, pulled pork y brisket, acompañados de guarniciones caseras como mac and cheese, frijoles horneados y collard greens.
parrafo_1.en: 4K's BBQ and Catering smokes its meat fresh every day in Clearwater: pork ribs, beef ribs, pulled pork and brisket, served with homemade sides like mac and cheese, baked beans and collard greens.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas en Google repiten lo mismo: el humo en las costillas y el brisket sorprende incluso a quienes conocen la barbacoa de Memphis o Texas, y el equipo del mostrador conoce el menú al detalle y atiende rápido.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep saying the same thing in their Google reviews: the smoke on the ribs and brisket impresses even people who know Memphis and Texas barbecue, and the counter team knows the menu inside out and moves fast.

texto.es: Cuéntanos si buscas un plato para pasar a buscar o catering completo para tu evento.
texto.en: Tell them if you want a plate to pick up or full catering for your event.

texto.es: Eliges entre costillas, brisket, pulled pork y las guarniciones caseras, y te dan un precio claro según tu evento.
texto.en: You choose between ribs, brisket, pulled pork and the homemade sides, and they give you a clear price based on your event.

texto.es: Cada corte se ahúma lento el mismo día, igual que lo describen las reseñas.
texto.en: Every cut is smoked low and slow the same day, exactly as the reviews describe.

texto.es: Pasas por el local en Clearwater o coordinan la entrega para tu evento.
texto.en: You pick up at the Clearwater location or they coordinate delivery for your event.

nota.es: Cada evento se cotiza según el número de invitados y el menú elegido. Llama y te dan el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every event is quoted based on guest count and the menu you pick. Call and they will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Costillas de cerdo, costillas de res y brisket ahumados lento, la razón por la que los clientes vuelven según sus reseñas en Google.
texto.en: Pork ribs, beef ribs and brisket smoked low and slow, the reason clients keep coming back according to their Google reviews.

texto.es: Catering completo para cumpleaños, bodas y eventos de empresa, con las mismas carnes ahumadas y guarniciones del local.
texto.en: Full catering for birthdays, weddings and company events, with the same smoked meats and sides served at the restaurant.

texto.es: Platos individuales con pulled pork, pollo o salchicha ahumada, acompañados de mac and cheese, frijoles o collard greens.
texto.en: Individual plates with pulled pork, chicken or smoked sausage, served alongside mac and cheese, baked beans or collard greens.

texto.es: Mac and cheese, frijoles horneados, collard greens y camote, todas hechas en el local según cuentan las reseñas.
texto.en: Mac and cheese, baked beans, collard greens and candied yams, all made in house according to the reviews.

pie.es: ¿Tu evento necesita algo distinto? Llama igual, seguro lo arman.
pie.en: Need something different for your event? Call anyway, they can likely put it together.
